_comment: Hand-curated client wiring for the `vyomi mcp` server. Merged into cmd/vyomi/mcp_matrix.json by scripts/gen_mcp_matrix.py.
Everything here is client-side knowledge that is NOT derivable from providers/*.py: which env vars real SDKs honor,
which data planes need TLS (:9443 via caddy), and which backends are separate emulator containers.
Primary sources: README.md 'Using your existing cloud SDKs', samples/java/cloud-probe/.../ProbeEnv.java,
Placeholders rendered by the Go server: {sim} = http://<host>:<sim_port>, {sim_hostport} = <host>:<sim_port>,
Since knowledge v2 the wiring is per home: homes.offline is the v3/v4.0.0 appliance (:9000, TLS :9443), homes.nano the browser tab via
the local tunnel (D0), homes.mesh a Pro/Max mesh (same surface as offline). capability_aliases maps services/registry.json keys to

offline._comment: The v3 and v4.0.0 offline appliance: simulator :9000, caddy TLS :9443, separate gRPC emulators.

env.name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL
env.note: Honored by current AWS CLI v2 and SDKs; older SDKs need endpoint_url / endpointOverride in code.

env.name: AWS_PAGER
env.note: Stops AWS CLI v2's pager swallowing short output.

notes: One endpoint serves every AWS service: the simulator routes by SigV4 scope / X-Amz-Target / Query Action.
S3 is path-style: set forcePathStyle=true (JS v3) or s3={'addressing_style':'path'} (boto3) if virtual-host addressing fails.
aws.terraform:
provider "aws" {
  region                      = "us-east-1"
  access_key                  = "test"
  secret_key                  = "test"
  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
  skip_metadata_api_check     = true
  s3_use_path_style           = true
  endpoints {
    s3       = "{sim}"
    sqs      = "{sim}"
    dynamodb = "{sim}"
    lambda   = "{sim}"
    iam      = "{sim}"
    ec2      = "{sim}"
    rds      = "{sim}"
    kms      = "{sim}"
    sns      = "{sim}"
    secretsmanager = "{sim}"
  }
}

env.name: STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST
env.note: GCS rides the simulator endpoint.

env.name: PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST
env.note: Separate gRPC emulator container, NOT the simulator port.

env.name: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST
env.note: Separate gRPC emulator container, NOT the simulator port.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.note: Use your active space's project id if it differs.

notes: On the Max tier (Multipass VM) replace the host with the VM IP for :8085/:8080 if localhost isn't bridged.
Secret Manager and Cloud KMS have no Google emulator: use the REST/HttpJson transport against https://{tls_hostport} (caddy) and trust its certificate.
gcloud command adapters are partial; prefer client libraries.
gcp.terraform_note: UNVERIFIED against Vyomi: custom_endpoint overrides per google service; confirm with a conformance run before relying on it.

env.name: AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING
env.note: Well-known Azurite key; the simulator ignores SharedKey signatures. *.localtest.me resolves to 127.0.0.1.

env.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
env.note: The only subscription a space has; any other id returns SubscriptionNotFound.

env.name: AZURE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_ENDPOINT
env.note: Pass as the ARM base_url / $host / cloud.Configuration ResourceManager endpoint; any credential is accepted.

env.name: AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT
env.note: Cosmos SDKs require TLS: goes through caddy :9443, trust its certificate.

env.name: AZURE_KEYVAULT_URL
env.note: Key Vault SDKs require TLS and rebuild paths from the host, so use the host-based form.

notes: Service Bus: the simulator speaks the Service Bus REST protocol only. AMQP (the default transport of azure-servicebus / @azure/service-bus / azure-messaging-servicebus) is NOT supported; use REST send/receive under {sim}/azure-data/servicebus, or Azure Storage Queues for point-to-point.
Blob requests share :9000 with S3; the simulator routes them by the x-ms-version header, so keep the account as the first path segment.
azure.terraform_note: Vyomi's Terraform workflow (core/terraform_export.py) covers the aws and google providers only. Provision Azure resources with az CLI / the ARM SDKs pointed at {sim}.

_comment: Nano: the simulator runs in a browser tab; local SDKs reach it through the local tunnel (vyomi-tunnel, http://127.0.0.1:8090) or the cloud relay URL from the Nano footer.
Every value comes from D0 (docs/architecture/v4.0/MCP-V4-DISCOVERY.md section 1); 'verified': false marks a value D0 did not exercise on Nano.
'unavailable' lists settings an SDK cannot use through the Nano tunnel: the MCP drops them and returns the warning instead.
'scan_warnings' replaces scan.warnings for this home (the offline ones talk about :9443 and separate emulators).

env.name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL
env.note: The local tunnel forwards to the Nano tab; keep the tab open. Older SDKs need endpoint_url / endpointOverride in code.

env.name: AWS_PAGER
env.note: Stops AWS CLI v2's pager swallowing short output.

notes: One endpoint serves every AWS service; plain HTTP only (there is no TLS endpoint on Nano).
S3 is path-style: set forcePathStyle=true (JS v3) or s3={'addressing_style':'path'} (boto3) if virtual-host addressing fails.
SNS->SQS fan-out works on Nano (verified with boto3).
RDS Data API on Nano: single statements answer, but a table created in one ExecuteStatement call is not visible to the next one today (D0 row 7).
aws.terraform:
provider "aws" {
  region                      = "us-east-1"
  access_key                  = "test"
  secret_key                  = "test"
  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
  skip_metadata_api_check     = true
  s3_use_path_style           = true
  endpoints {
    s3       = "{sim}"
    sqs      = "{sim}"
    dynamodb = "{sim}"
    lambda   = "{sim}"
    iam      = "{sim}"
    ec2      = "{sim}"
    rds      = "{sim}"
    kms      = "{sim}"
    sns      = "{sim}"
    secretsmanager = "{sim}"
  }
}
aws.terraform_note: UNVERIFIED on Nano: D0 did not run Terraform through the tunnel.

env.name: STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST
env.note: GCS rides the tunnel endpoint (plain HTTP).

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.note: Nano's project id (alias of nano-project); 'cloudlearn' is rejected with 403/404.

unavailable.name: PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST
unavailable.warning: google-cloud-pubsub speaks gRPC (HTTP/2) and the Nano tunnel is HTTP/1.1 only, so the client hangs. Use the Pub/Sub REST API at {sim}/v1/projects/vyomi-project/... (works on Nano), or a Pro/Max mesh for the gRPC emulator.

unavailable.name: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST
unavailable.warning: google-cloud-firestore speaks gRPC (HTTP/2) and the Nano tunnel is HTTP/1.1 only, so the client hangs. Use the Firestore REST API at {sim}/v1/projects/vyomi-project/databases/(default)/documents (works on Nano), or a Pro/Max mesh for the gRPC emulator.

notes: Pub/Sub and Firestore: REST (JSON) only on Nano, at {sim}/v1/projects/vyomi-project/...; the gRPC client libraries do not work through the tunnel.
Secret Manager and Cloud KMS: REST against {sim} over plain HTTP (unverified on Nano).
gcloud command adapters are partial; prefer client libraries.
gcp.terraform_note: UNVERIFIED on Nano: D0 did not run Terraform through the tunnel.

env.name: AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING
env.note: Well-known Azurite key; path-style Blob and host-style Queue endpoints both work through the tunnel. *.localtest.me resolves to 127.0.0.1.

env.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
env.note: The only subscription a space has (unverified on Nano).

env.name: AZURE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_ENDPOINT
env.note: ARM base_url for the management SDKs; any credential is accepted (unverified on Nano).

env.name: AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT
env.note: Plain HTTP, root endpoint (not /azure-data/cosmos/<account>). Verified with Python azure-cosmos; other-language SDKs may insist on https.

env.name: AZURE_SERVICEBUS_CONNECTION_STRING
env.note: AMQP on {host}:5672 through the tunnel's amqp feature. Create the queue/topic first (Nano console, or REST PUT {sim}/<name> with an atom+xml TopicDescription); ServiceBusAdministrationClient needs HTTPS and fails.

unavailable.name: AZURE_KEYVAULT_URL
unavailable.warning: Key Vault needs TLS; not available through the Nano tunnel (the SDKs refuse bearer tokens on plain-HTTP URLs). Use a Pro/Max mesh (https :9443), or see vyomi_capability.

notes: Service Bus: AMQP works through the Nano tunnel (UseDevelopmentEmulator=true, port 5672); entities must exist before the first send.
Blob and Queue share the endpoint; keep the account as the first path segment, or use the host form <account>.blob.localtest.me:<port>.
azure.terraform_note: Vyomi's Terraform workflow (core/terraform_export.py) covers the aws and google providers only. Provision Azure resources with az CLI / the ARM SDKs pointed at {sim}.

scan_warnings.azure/cosmos: Cosmos on Nano: plain HTTP at the root endpoint (AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT={sim}); verified with Python azure-cosmos, other SDKs may insist on https (then use a Pro/Max mesh).
scan_warnings.azure/keyvault: Key Vault needs TLS; not available through the Nano tunnel (the SDKs refuse bearer tokens on plain-HTTP URLs). Use a Pro/Max mesh (https :9443), or keep Key Vault on the real cloud for now.
scan_warnings.azure/servicebus: Service Bus on Nano: AMQP works through the local tunnel (Endpoint=sb://{host};...;UseDevelopmentEmulator=true, port 5672). Create queues/topics first (Nano console, or REST PUT {sim}/<name>); ServiceBusAdministrationClient needs HTTPS and fails.
scan_warnings.gcp/pubsub: Pub/Sub on Nano: the gRPC client libraries do not work through the HTTP/1.1 tunnel; use the REST API at {sim}/v1/projects/vyomi-project/... or a Pro/Max mesh.
scan_warnings.gcp/firestore: Firestore on Nano: the gRPC client libraries do not work through the HTTP/1.1 tunnel; use the REST API at {sim}/v1/projects/vyomi-project/databases/(default)/documents or a Pro/Max mesh.
scan_warnings.gcp/secretmanager: Secret Manager on Nano: REST against {sim} over plain HTTP (unverified).
scan_warnings.gcp/kms: Cloud KMS on Nano: REST against {sim} over plain HTTP (unverified).

mesh._comment: A Pro/Max mesh serves the same :9000/:9443 surface as the offline appliance (spec section 2); not re-verified by D0.

warnings.azure/servicebus: Service Bus SDKs default to AMQP, which the simulator does not support. Use the Service Bus REST protocol ({sim}/azure-data/servicebus) or Azure Storage Queues.
warnings.azure/cosmos: Cosmos SDKs require TLS: point them at https://{tls_hostport}/azure-data/cosmos/<account> and trust the caddy certificate.
warnings.azure/keyvault: Key Vault SDKs require TLS and host-based URLs: https://<vault>.vault.localtest.me:{tls_port}.
warnings.gcp/secretmanager: No Google emulator exists: use the REST/HttpJson transport against https://{tls_hostport}.
warnings.gcp/kms: No Google emulator exists: use the REST/HttpJson transport against https://{tls_hostport}.
warnings.gcp/pubsub: Pub/Sub is a separate emulator: set PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST={host}:8085 (not the simulator port).
warnings.gcp/firestore: Firestore is a separate emulator: set FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST={host}:8080 (not the simulator port).
warnings.azure/cognitiveservices: Azure OpenAI in Vyomi is SIMULATED (deterministic, labelled output, no real model): AzureOpenAI(azure_endpoint={sim}/azure-data/openai/<account>, api_key=<account key>). Good for wiring and tests, not for judging model quality.

_id_aliases_comment: capabilities.py / pack ids that differ from the services/registry.json key.
_capability_aliases_comment: services/registry.json key -> core/capabilities stem ('<stem>' or '<stem>#<id prefix>'), where they differ.
